name: Spaceship c15dd310 on the 3-uniform tiling k3-013
description: A period-5 spaceship on the 3-uniform tiling k3-013 (touching neighbours), 4 to 5 cells, moving one lattice step every 5 generations (c/5). It runs the same way in the 131,072 rules from B3/S2 to B3,6,7,8,9,10,11,12/S0,2,4,5,6,7,8,9,10,11,12; the scene uses the rule it was found in. The same object runs unchanged on k3-019. JETCARP's soup search found it on k3-019 (seen 229 times). To our knowledge not reported before.
